sentences.text:
THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
CORAM:
THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR  -3-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:12888  CRL.P No. 100650 of 2024  ORAL ORDER

This petition is filed by accused Nos.3 to 7 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C praying to quash the complaint and FIR of Gangavathi Rural Police Station in Crime No.13/2024 registered for offences under Sections 498-A, 504, 506, 149 and 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Respondent No.2 has filed complaint and the same came to be registered in the Gangavati Rural Police Station in Crime No.13/2024 against the petitioners and other accused for the aforesaid offences.
The petitioners have sought for quashing of the proceedings in Crime No.13/2024.

3. The respondent No.2 is present before the Court has filed her affidavit, wherein it is stated that she has settled the matter with the petitioners and she is not interested in prosecuting the present petition and she has no objections to quash the proceedings against the petitioners.
The respondent No.2 who is present before the NC: 2024:KHC-D:12888 Court submits that there is no force or coercion of anybody to enter into compromise.
4. In view of the above, the proceedings against the petitioners of Gangavathi Rural Police Station in Crime No.13/2024 are quashed.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.

Sd/-
(SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR) JUDGE PJ CT:ANB Lalitha Deepti W/O. Suresh Thumpati vs The State Of Karnataka on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55792931/
